# CS201 Algorithms — Module Manual
This module introduces the design and analysis of algorithms.
Students who are not able to attend the lab must notify the lecturer in advance.

## Learning outcomes
On successful completion of this module, students will be able to:
- explain the principle of divide and conquer
- implement binary search and hash tables in Python
- analyse the running time of recursive algorithms
- summarise the trade-offs between common data structures

## Assessment
Students will receive their grades within four weeks after the exam.
Students should bring a laptop to every lab session.

## Weekly schedule
Week 1: Sorting and complexity
Week 2: Binary search
Week 3 (12 Oct): Hash tables
Week 4 - Graph traversal
Week 5: Reading week (no lecture)
Week 6: Midterm exam
outcomes: explain the principle of divide and conquer
implement binary search and hash tables in Python
analyse the running time of recursive algorithms
summarise the trade-offs between common data structures

Course description
The course covers relational databases. Students will be assigned to lab groups in the first week.
CLO1: Design a normalised relational schema for a given scenario.
CLO2: Formulate SQL queries with joins and aggregation.
CLO3: Evaluate the isolation level required by an application.
By the end of the course, participants can explain how a query optimiser chooses a plan.
The lecturer will be able to answer questions during office hours.
Prerequisites: Students should have completed Programming 1.
Schedule
Wk 1: Relational model
Wk 2: SQL basics
Wk. 3: Normalisation
Lecture 4: Transactions
Week 5 deadline: submit assignment 1
In week 2 we had 30 students in the lab.

Module: Operating Systems
Intended learning outcomes
1. Describe the life cycle of a process.
2. Compare scheduling strategies with respect to fairness.
3. Implement a simple memory allocator in C.
Teaching methods
Lectures and weekly labs. Attendance in the labs is compulsory.
Students are expected to be able to program in C before the course starts.
Timetable
Session 1: Processes and threads
Session 2: Scheduling
Session 3: No class (public holiday)
Session 4: Memory management
outcomes: Describe the life cycle of a process.
Compare scheduling strategies with respect to fairness.
Implement a simple memory allocator in C.

# INF201 Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen — Modulhandbuch
Dieses Modul behandelt Entwurf und Analyse grundlegender Algorithmen.

## Lernziele
Die Studierenden können die binäre Suche erklären und ihre Komplexität bewerten.
Die Studierenden sind in der Lage, Hashtabellen zu implementieren.

Die Studierenden sollen einen Laptop zu den Übungen mitbringen.
